references.text: The same ritual of sprinkling seven times and releasing the bird is repeated in the cleansing of a house with leprosy
Sprinkling seven times is part of the cleansing ritual, similar to the practice of sprinkling blood before the veil
Ritual sprinkling with hyssop for cleansing from impurity, which also involves seven days
The Letter to the Hebrews refers to cleansing rituals with blood and how Christ's blood cleanses the conscience
The live bird that is released recalls the scapegoat sent out into the wilderness on the Day of Atonement
David asks to be cleansed with hyssop, a reference to the cleansing rituals in the Law of Moses
Naaman was told to wash himself seven times in the Jordan River to be cleansed from leprosy
